title: SREV-001 directory information buffer shape

record_shape.description: Official FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFORMATION variable-size record with NextEntryOffset, FileNameLength byte count, and variable FileName payload

alignment_shape.description: MS-FSCC alignment: each non-final NextEntryOffset is 8-byte aligned and alignment bytes are zero

merge_dummy_capacity.description: FIELD_OFFSET(FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFORMATION, FileName) + FileNameLength must fit in remaining info_area bytes before any write

length_unit.description: FileNameLength is a byte count, not a WCHAR index; no trailing NUL is required because cache conversion uses the byte length directly

fit_semantics.description: If staging area cannot hold the next complete record, stop appending and return complete records already staged; no partial record is written

runtime_matrix.description: Windows directory enumeration runtime proof under many matching open/readable path rules

contracts: FILE_ID_BOTH_DIR_INFORMATION is a variable-size record terminated by NextEntryOffset==0
FileNameLength is a length in bytes of the file name string
FileName[1] is the first character of a variable-length file name payload
Each non-final NextEntryOffset is aligned on an 8-byte boundary
Alignment bytes between records should be zero per MS-FSCC
File_MergeDummy must check remaining info_area capacity before appending a synthetic record
File_MergeDummy must treat FileNameLength as a byte count, not a WCHAR index
File_MergeDummy must not write a partial record when the staging area is full
